galleryLostRelease.change: A gallery remembers failed pictures by search, not by item id: a gallery redrawn under the same ids hid pictures that were found (production call dfbb0ead). board-image answers 503 for a lookup that could not be made (image search 429 or timeout) and 404 for no picture; the page retries a 503 once after 2.5 s and does not keep it. searchWordsRelease.gatewayNote: The Gateway had been restarted at 2026-11-20 23:28:56 CST, before this release and not by it (PID 869872 before and after publishing).
searchWordsRelease.change: Picture searches: results qualify on their own score (their place only orders them); words the search asks for are not held against a title; guide, data and download pages are; a Chinese title must name the thing (half its characters), and an English title sharing no word with a several-word search for a Chinese name does not count for it. A search that finds nothing worth fetching is tried without its kind-of-picture words, then without its last word. An encyclopedia redirect to another article (a list with the Pokemon logo) is not the thing.
searchWordsRelease.acceptance: Tianyi reported GTA6 pictures missing on 11/20 and asked to release after the rerun of the day's 77 production searches on the Candidate (77 found, was 65; none lost). Production Public call after publish, 1440x900, '给我找几张GTA6的图看看，主角杰森和露西娅的': V described 5 pictures and all 5 were on the page; 5 of 5 lookups found.
